tools.name: read_program
tools.description: Read Creditable’s published builder offer and submission rules. No cash check size, duration, funding guarantee or review deadline is published. Applying creates no commitment.

tools.name: validate_submission
tools.description: Check founder-approved project details against the existing intake schema without saving or sending an application. Does not return the applicant’s personal details.

tools.name: submit_project
tools.description: Send an actual founder-approved startup submission to Creditable’s private review queue. Requires explicit confirmation, founder_authorized:true and review/contact consent. Reuse the exact UUID and body after a timeout. Success requires saved:true and a reference; it is not selection or funding. No

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_program · Private data: submit_project · Public sink: submit_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_program · Private data: submit_project · Public sink: submit_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
